item.title: Santa Cruz Burger Week plates up for the ninth year
item.description: Santa Cruz Burger Week returns for its ninth year next month, offering diners a chance to sample creative takes on a classic favorite. The 12-day event, presented by Santa Cruz Restaurant Week and Good Times, runs Feb. 25 through March 8 and features specially priced burgers from restaurants across Santa Cruz County. item.title: MioCar is in Watsonville
item.description: The City of Watsonville has started a new electric vehicle car sharing program, where anyone over 21 with a valid driver’s license, a relatively clean driving record and a valid credit, debit, or bank card can access EV car-sharing. Starting at $4/hour, MioCar allows the public to drive an EV for errands, hauling groceries, and […]

item.title: Watsonville boys’ soccer battle in scoreless draw against Gonzales | Weeklys Sports Roundup
item.description: The Watsonville High boys’ soccer team clinched at least a share of the Pacific Coast Athletic League Mission Division title following a 0-0 draw against Gonzales on Thursday night.
